name: Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport
before:
Chongqing's airport, about 19 km north of the city centre, and ninth busiest in mainland China. It is a major hub for western Chinese carriers including Sichuan Airlines, Hainan Airlines, West Air, China Express and Chongqing Airlines.

Terminal 3A is where an international client will be. Opened in August 2017 with 66 gates and rated for 45 million passengers a year, it handles all international flights plus a share of domestic. Terminal 2, with its two concourses and 30 gates, is domestic only. Terminal 1, the original 1990 building, closed in August 2017.

The two live terminals sit some distance apart, Terminal 2 on the western perimeter and Terminal 3A to the south east, linked by metro line 10 and a free shuttle bus. Allow real time for a transfer between them.

A new satellite terminal, 3B, and a fourth runway both finished construction in 2025.

Airports Council International named it the best airport in its size category in both 2017 and 2018.
after:
Chongqing's main international airport, about 19 km north of the city centre. In 2025 it was the ninth busiest in mainland China.

It now has four runways.
